data.summary: Gyre Prime is primarily a frontline damage dealer with moderate survivability and limited support capabilities. Its abilities are straightforward and do not require complex execution, making it relatively simple to use. However, its lack of stealth and crowd control abilities limits its versatility in certain situations.
